items.title: CosmicSting Attack: Crypt Key Theft and Backdoors
items.summary: The CosmicSting vulnerability allows attackers to steal crypt keys, mint admin API tokens, export customer data, and inject skimmers into CMS blocks. Sansec observed stores being hacked at a rate of 5 to 30 per hour.

items.title: SessionReaper: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
items.summary: SessionReaper is a critical bug in Magento and Adobe Commerce that enables unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE), potentially giving attackers full control of a store. Automated attacks have impacted over 50% of all stores.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security bulletin addresses seven vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362) that could lead to customer account takeover and privilege escalation. Other issues include high-severity stored cross-site scripting and incorrect authorization vulnerabilities.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a security update resolving critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service. This bulletin includes CVE-2025-49554, CVE-2025-49555, CVE-2025-49556, and CVE-2025-49557.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Amasty Extensions Critical Vulnerabilities
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for dozens of its Magento extensions, addressing two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution. Sansec Shield already blocks these critical issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution. The vulnerability has a critical CVSS score of 9.3.

items.title: Critical Vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer allows remote code execution via a crafted CacheWarmer cookie on any storefront request. The flaw is tracked as CVE-2026-45247 and rated 9.8 (critical).
